Escape Specifications
Standard Features
Mechanical Exterior
6-speed SelectShift automatic transmission Body-color front and rear fascias
with Sport Mode Body-color rear spoiler
4-wheel independent suspension Easy Fuel® capless fuel filler
Electric power-assisted steering Power sideview mirrors with integrated blind spot
Front and rear stabilizer bar mirrors and manual fold-away design
Front-wheel drive (FWD) Rear-window defroster
Mini spare wheel and tire Solar-tinted glass
Power disc brakes with Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Windshield wipers – Front: variable-intermittent
Torque Vectoring Control with washer; rear: 2-speed with washer
Seating Safety & Security
Front bucket seats Personal Safety System™ for driver and front
passenger includes dual-stage front airbags,3 safety
Front-passenger seat back map pocket
belt pretensioners, safety belt energy-management
60/40 split-fold rear bench seat with recline retractors, safety belt usage sensors, driver’s seat
and tip-fold-flat latch position sensor, crash severity sensor, restraint control
module and Front-Passenger Sensing System
Interior
3-point safety belt restraint system for all
12-volt powerpoints (4) seating positions
Adjustable driver and front-passenger sun visors Adjustable head restraints at all 5 seating positions
with covered vanity mirrors
AdvanceTrac® with RSC® (Roll Stability Control™)
Air conditioning with particulate air filter and Curve Control
Cargo floor hooks (4) Battery saver
